title: SettingsSection
wrapsNative: MonarchSectionCard with androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow in its footer; rows are MonarchSwitchRow, MonarchFormField with the Row layout and MonarchListRow
summary: A recipe, not a component: a titled group of settings in a card, with a save footer that appears while there are unsaved changes, a danger zone, and loading and no-access states.
whenToUse: For each group of an app's settings screen, such as a workspace's general settings or its danger zone.
whenNotToUse: For switches that save one by one, use MonarchSwitchSettingsList. For a bar of Save and Discard pinned to the bottom of a long form, use MonarchFormActionsBar.
api: MonarchSectionCard(title = "Workspace", description = …, busy = saving, footer = { … Discard and Save changes … }) { rows }
MonarchSwitchRow(checked = digest, onCheckedChange = …, label = "Weekly digest", description = …)
MonarchFormField(label = "Language", layout = MonarchFormFieldLayout.Row) { controlModifier -> MonarchSelect(…, modifier = controlModifier) }

MonarchSectionCard(title = "Danger zone", tone = MonarchTone.Danger) { MonarchListRow(headlineContent = …, supportingContent = …, trailingContent = { MonarchButton(…, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Danger) }) }
MonarchSectionCard(title = …, state = MonarchSectionCardState.Loading, labels = MonarchSectionCardLabels(loading = "Loading settings")) {}
MonarchSectionCard(title = …, state = MonarchSectionCardState.Empty, emptyMessage = …, labels = MonarchSectionCardLabels(emptyTitle = "You don’t have access to these settings")) {}

options.name: dirty
options.description: The draft differs from the saved settings: the footer says so in a polite live region and enables Discard and Save changes.

options.name: saving
options.description: Passed to Save changes' loading and to the card's busy; Discard is disabled meanwhile.

options.name: tone
options.description: MonarchTone.Danger on the card for a danger zone: a danger border, spoken with the title.

states.name: ready
states.description: The title, the description and the rows; no footer actions are enabled while nothing has changed.

states.name: dirty
states.description: "You have unsaved changes." in the footer, announced politely, with Discard and Save changes enabled.

states.name: saving
states.description: Save changes shows its progress indicator, the title reads busy and Discard is disabled.

states.name: loading
states.description: MonarchSectionCardState.Loading: skeleton rows announced as "Loading settings".

states.name: no access
states.description: MonarchSectionCardState.Empty with the no-access title and who can change the settings, in place of the rows and the footer.

states.name: danger zone
states.description: A card with the danger tone and MonarchListRow rows whose action is a danger button that opens a confirmation.

appearance: Every part is an existing Monarch or Material 3 component: the section card's surface, border and header, switch and form-field rows, Material 3 list items on the surface color, and small secondary and primary buttons in a footer under a line. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The parity map named a MonarchSettingsSection type; following the native-first rule it is a recipe, because MonarchSectionCard already gives the titled card, its loading and empty states, the busy state, a danger tone and a footer slot, and the rows are existing Monarch rows and the MonarchListRow. The web's SettingsRow is MonarchFormField with the Row layout (or MonarchSwitchRow for a switch), and its SettingsActionRow is a MonarchListRow with a trailing button. The web's stickyFooter is MonarchFormActionsBar, the Android bottom bar for Save and Discard; the web's no-access notice is the card's empty state. iOS plans a MonarchSettingsSectionStyle for its Form sections and has not shipped it yet.
accessibility: The title is a heading and the danger tone is spoken with it, from MonarchSectionCard.
Switch rows are one TalkBack element with the switch role; form-field rows name their control by the label.
The unsaved-changes line is a polite live region, so it is announced when it appears.
Discard and Save changes are MonarchButtons with 48dp targets; Save changes reads "Loading" while saving.
The footer wraps onto more lines at large font sizes.
edgeCases: Keep Save changes enabled only while dirty; Discard restores the saved values the app keeps.
When a save fails, keep the draft and show the error with MonarchInlineNotice in the card.
For a long settings screen with several sections, prefer one MonarchFormActionsBar for the whole screen over a footer per section.
